translations.web: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
translations.bsb: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
translations.kjv: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have ➔ no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
translations.asv: And if any man obeyeth not our word by this epistle, note that man, that ye have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
